fix_description: In CPowerRenameRegEx::Replace the replace term is pre-processed for capture-group tokens ($0-$9 via zeroGroupRegex/otherGroupsRegex) with $$-escaping to protect literal '$' before the regex engine formats the output. That escaping mis-handles a date token: the '$DD' sequence is consumed/altered as if it were a group reference or an unescaped '$', so it is dropped by the engine and never reaches GetDatedFileName, while the other date tokens ($YYYY,$MM,$hh,$mm,$ss) are preserved and expanded normally. Fix the zeroGroupRegex/otherGroupsRegex rewrite and the '$$' escaping so any '$' not forming a real capture-group reference (i.e. date/metadata '$'-tokens) is correctly escaped and passed through verbatim, then verify with new cases added to unittests/CommonRegExTests.h against both the std::regex and boost::regex engines.
